title: Reports of licensees.
bodyText: Each licensee shall as required by rule or order of the board of agriculture and biosecurity, file a verified report on forms prescribed by the board of matters on account of which a record is required to be kept, together with such other information or facts as may be pertinent and material within the scope of this chapter.
bodyHtml: §157-27  Reports of licensees.  Each licensee shall as required by rule or order of the board of agriculture and biosecurity, file a verified report on forms prescribed by the board of matters on account of which a record is required to be kept, together with such other information or facts as may be pertinent and material within the scope of this chapter. [L 1967, c 260, §18; HRS §157-27; am L 2025, c 236, §18]
